basis: Geraniol 8-hydroxylase (CYP76B6), first committed iridoid step; IPAP by in situ (Burlat et al. 2004 Plant J) and again by RIH in Sun 2023 (Ext Data Fig 7); cluster-specific in Li 2023 (67% vs <=5%) and Sun 2023 (46x next type; same UniProt Q8VWZ7). Cross-study.

Plastidial geraniol synthase, entry to the iridoid branch; IPAP by in situ (Simkin et al. 2013 Phytochemistry); IPAP-specific in Li 2023 (48% vs <=2%) and Sun 2023 GES (57x). Sun matched by name only (UniProt J9PZR5, auto-annotated "myrcene synthase"); v3 ID from Li 2023 Table S6.

8-hydroxygeraniol oxidoreductase; IPAP by in situ (Miettinen et al. 2014 Nat Commun); Li 2023 59% vs <=5%; Sun 2023 8HGO 20x (same UniProt W8JWV8). Li Source Data 4b-2 counts the split v3 locus CRO_01G027010/CRO_01G027020; Table S6 lists only 027010.
Iridoid oxidase (CYP76A26); IPAP by in situ (Miettinen et al. 2014 Nat Commun); Li 2023 77% vs <=13% (Table S8 IPAP marker); Sun 2023 7DLS 36x (same UniProt W8JIS5). Cross-study.
7-deoxyloganic acid 7-hydroxylase (CYP72A224); IPAP by in situ (Miettinen et al. 2014 Nat Commun); Li 2023 38% vs <=8% (Table S8 IPAP marker); Sun 2023 DL7H 5x (same UniProt U5NE19).

7-deoxyloganetic acid glucosyltransferase (UGT709C2); IPAP by in situ (cited in Li 2023 Fig 4b); IPAP-enriched in Li 2023 and Sun 2023 (7x; UniProt U3U992 = U5NH37, same gene). Kept medium: v3 locus is split over CRO_05G028780-810 (Table S6); Li code uses 028810, check which is expressed.

Iridoid synthase (UniProt K7WDL7); no in situ asterisk in Li 2023; IPAP-specific in Li 2023 (33% vs <=1%) and Sun 2023 IRS (37x): two independent studies raise low to medium. Li Source Data counts CRO_07G007680/690; paralog ISP is CRO_07G007670.

MEP-pathway reductoisomerase; IPAP by in situ (Burlat et al. 2004 Plant J); Li 2023 51% vs <=12%; Sun 2023 18x (same UniProt Q9M4W4). Primary-metabolism enzyme, so not a type-defining function; cross-study agreement raises medium to high.
MEP-pathway cyclodiphosphate synthase; IPAP by in situ (Burlat et al. 2004 Plant J); Li 2023 33% vs <=12%; Sun 2023 MECS 7x (same UniProt Q9M4W3). Cross-study raises medium to high.

MEP-pathway DXS; IPAP by in situ (Burlat et al. 2004 Plant J) but broad background in Li 2023 (38% vs 6-13%). Sun 2023 has three DXS paralogs (one IPAP-specific, one not), and which one is CRO_02G005470 is unknown, so no cross-study raise.
MEP-pathway HDS; IPAP-enriched in Li 2023 Source Data 4b-2 (57% vs <=21%) and Sun 2023 (22x). Sun matched by name only (UniProt Q84XR5, no accession for the Li locus), so not raised.
REVIEW: Sun 2023 EVM ID (genome PRJNA841429), no v3 CRO_ ID mapped. Methylesterase (SABP2 homolog); IPAP by RIH (Sun 2023 Ext Data Fig 4) and 45x IPAP specificity there; not tested in Li 2023.

Tryptophan decarboxylase, epidermal tryptamine supply for MIAs; epidermis by in situ (St-Pierre et al. 1999 Plant Cell) and by RIH in Sun 2023 (Ext Data Fig 7); Li 2023 33% vs <=7%; Sun 2023 EC 4x (same UniProt P17770). Two independent in situ studies.
16-hydroxytabersonine O-methyltransferase (vindoline branch); epidermis by in situ (cited in Li 2023 Fig 4b); Li 2023 17% vs <=7%; Sun 2023 EC 20x (same UniProt B0EXJ8). Cross-study.

Secologanin synthase (CYP72A1); epidermis by in situ (cited in Li 2023 Fig 4b); Li 2023 23% vs <=6%. Sun 2023 maps four SLS paralogs to the same UniProt (Q05047), all epidermis-biased (2-4x), so the cross-study match is not locus-resolved.

Strictosidine beta-glucosidase (nuclear); epidermis by in situ (Guirimand et al. 2010 BMC Plant Biol); Li 2023 16% vs <=2% (low detection). Sun 2023 SGD1/SGD2 share one UniProt (Q9M7N7), EC-biased 2-3x; locus match not resolved. Li Table S6 calls it SGD.

Loganic acid O-methyltransferase; epidermis by in situ (cited in Li 2023 Fig 4b) but broad in both scRNA datasets: Li 2023 E 55%, M 29%, IP 20%; Sun 2023 1.3x (same UniProt B2KPR3). Use for specificity, not presence.

Strictosidine synthase; epidermis by in situ (St-Pierre et al. 1999 Plant Cell), but conflict: not specific in Li 2023 (E 10%, M 9%, IP 7%) or Sun 2023 (top type IPAP, 1.1x; same UniProt P18417). Low until shown in your data.
Catharanthine synthase; epidermis-enriched in Li 2023 (52% vs IP 22%) and Sun 2023 (10x, UniProt A0A2P1GIW2). No in situ; Sun match by name only, so not raised.
Secologanin MATE transporter (VIGS phenotype in Li 2023 Fig 3b); epidermis-enriched by scRNA only (E 41%, M 20%).
Ortholog of Arabidopsis KCS6/CER6 (AT1G68530), cuticular-wax elongase; Li 2023 Table S8 epidermis marker enriched in clusters 1/14. Function not tested in C. roseus.
REVIEW: Sun 2023 EVM ID, no v3 CRO_ ID mapped. Non-specific lipid-transfer protein; epidermis by RIH (Sun 2023 Ext Data Fig 4); highest in Sun EC1 (2.3x EC2, >10x non-epidermal).

Desacetoxyvindoline 4-hydroxylase, penultimate vindoline step; idioblast and laticifer by in situ (St-Pierre et al. 1999 Plant Cell); Li 2023 96% vs <=12%; Sun 2023 IC 53x (same UniProt O04847). Also marks laticifers if captured.

Deacetylvindoline O-acetyltransferase, last vindoline step; idioblast and laticifer by in situ (St-Pierre et al. 1999 Plant Cell); Li 2023 67% vs <=2%; Sun 2023 IC 146x (same UniProt Q9ZTK5). Also marks laticifers if captured.
N-methyltransferase of the vindoline branch; both studies place it in idioblast and epidermis (Li 2023 I 67%, E 47%; Sun 2023 IC 11.4 vs EC1 10.3, UniProt W5U2K2). Not specific; use with D4H/DAT.
Serpentine synthase (Yamamoto 2021); in the Li 2023 idioblast coexpression module (Fig 4c); serpentine accumulates in idioblasts. v3 locus split CRO_03G003540/550.
Idioblast MYB1, activates D4H/DAT promoters in transactivation assays; idioblast-specific in Li 2025 snRNA/ATAC multiome only (same lab and marker list as Li 2023, so not an independent agreement).

Ortholog of Arabidopsis FAMA (AT3G24140), guard-cell fate bHLH; Li 2023 Table S8 marker but no guard cluster there; Sun 2023 FAMA (EVM0017755) 26x in its GC cluster; Li 2025 called a guard cluster from a list that probably includes it (Table S4 not read). Locus corrected 2026-10-22: was CRO_06G007040, which is the MUTE (AT3G06120) RBH (68% id); CRO_06G006770 is the reciprocal best BLASTP hit of FAMA AT3G24140 in cro_v3 (63% id over 357 aa) and is 89% vs 0% in guard cells in the Li 2025 data (test run N3).
Ortholog of Arabidopsis beta carbonic anhydrase CA1 (AT3G01500); Li 2023 Table S8 mesophyll marker, also high in IPAP; Sun BCA1 1.0x (ambient). Use for specificity, not presence.
Ortholog of Arabidopsis LHCB2 (AT2G05100); Li 2023 Table S8 mesophyll marker; photosynthesis gene, ambient and also in IPAP. Second ortholog CRO_03G015510.
Ortholog of Arabidopsis LHCB1/CAB3 (AT1G29910); Li 2023 Table S8 mesophyll marker; photosynthesis gene, ambient.
REVIEW: Sun 2023 EVM ID, no v3 CRO_ ID mapped. LHCB (CAB 2.1); mesophyll by RIH (Sun 2023 Ext Data Fig 4) but not specific in scRNA (1.0x vs IC, IPAP, UN).
REVIEW: Sun 2023 EVM ID, no v3 CRO_ ID mapped. PR-10-like protein (STH-2 homolog); vascular cells by RIH (Sun 2023 Ext Data Fig 4) and 14x VC specificity there. Xylem vs phloem not resolved.
Ortholog of Arabidopsis TMO5 (AT3G25710), xylem-precursor/procambium bHLH; Li 2023 Table S8 vasculature marker in the merged vascular cluster 9. Second ortholog CRO_01G030870.
Ortholog of Arabidopsis WOX4 (AT1G46480), procambium/cambium; weak in Li 2023 vascular cluster 9 (Table S8).
Ortholog of Arabidopsis ACL5 (AT5G19530), thermospermine synthase of xylem vessels; Li 2023 Table S8 vasculature marker (cluster 9). Second ortholog CRO_01G029560.
Ortholog of Arabidopsis APL (AT1G79430), phloem identity MYB; weak in Li 2023 cluster 9. Sun 2023 APL (EVM0001919) is 29x VC-specific, but the locus match is by name only.

Ortholog of Arabidopsis SUC2 (AT1G22710), companion-cell sucrose loader; weak in Li 2023 cluster 9. Sun 2023 SUC2 (EVM0020471) 9x VC, name-level match. Li Table S8 gives a second SUC2 ortholog (CRO_07G008710) for root.

Ortholog of Arabidopsis SWEET11 (AT3G48740), phloem-parenchyma sucrose exporter. Label conflict: Li 2023 Table S8 calls it a "Ploem CC" marker (preprint-only cluster); Arabidopsis places SWEET11 in phloem parenchyma.
